nodes.description: bool isLotteryOpen: gate switch allowing ticket purchases
address POWM_address: hardcoded address of the POWM token contract
POWM maths: interface instance to external POWM token contract
address owner: privileged account set in the constructor from msg.sender
mapping(uint256 => address) gamblers: ticket index to buyer address
mapping(address => uint256) token_buyins: tickets bought per address
mapping(address => uint256) last_round_bought: anti double-buy guard per round
uint256 num_tickets_current_round: total tickets issued this round, used as modulo divisor
uint256 current_round: round counter
uint256 numTokensInLottery: cached POWM token balance held by contract
address masternode_referrer: referral address, becomes the winner
uint256 MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN: max tickets per purchase, owner controlled
PoWMLottery() constructor: sets current_round, owner and referrer
donateToLottery() payable: buys POWM tokens for the lottery and returns the delta
buyTickets() payable: buys POWM tokens and mints up to 25 tickets for msg.sender
setMaxTokenBuyin(uint256) onlyOwner: changes the ticket cap while lottery is closed
openLottery() onlyOwner: increments round and opens the lottery
fallback() payable: accepts dividends / ETH transfers
closeLotteryAndPickWinner() onlyOwner: pseudo-randomly picks a winner, transfers tokens and all ETH
msg.sender: attacker controllable caller, becomes owner, ticket holder, referrer and potential winner
block.timestamp / block.number / blockhash: miner-influenceable entropy source for winner selection
maths.buy.value(msg.value)(masternode_referrer) external payable call inside donateToLottery
maths.transfer(winner, exact_tokens) external token transfer to winner
winner.transfer(address(this).balance) raw ETH push to an attacker-controlled address (reentrancy / DoS)
maths.buy.value(msg.value)(masternode_referrer) external payable call inside buyTickets
uint256(keccak256(block.blockhash(block.number - 1))) % num_tickets_current_round: timestamp/block based randomness with modulo by zero risk
uint256 tokens: new ticket cap parameter of setMaxTokenBuyin
uint256 tokens_before: maths.myTokens() snapshot before buying
uint256 tokens_after: maths.myTokens() snapshot after buying
uint256 tokens_bought: (tokens_after - tokens_before).div(1e18), number of tickets
uint8 i: loop counter filling the gamblers mapping
uint256 winning_number: pseudo-random ticket index
address winner: gamblers[winning_number], recipient of tokens and ETH
uint256 exact_tokens: maths.myTokens() drained to the winner

edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the deployer/caller controls privileged functions
masternode_referrer is set from msg.sender and later overwritten with the winner
gamblers[num_tickets_current_round] = msg.sender writes the caller into the ticket table
token_buyins[msg.sender] = tokens_bought records the caller buy-in
last_round_bought[msg.sender] = current_round stores caller state
require(last_round_bought[msg.sender] != current_round) gates buyTickets on the caller address
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner for setMaxTokenBuyin
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner for openLottery
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner for closeLotteryAndPickWinner
a caller-controlled address can be selected as winner and receive the raw ETH transfer
block.blockhash/block.number/block.timestamp derived entropy decides the winner
winning_number is computed from the block-hash pseudo-random value
winner = gamblers[winning_number]
masternode_referrer = winner redirects referral rewards to the winner
maths.transfer(winner, exact_tokens) sends all POWM tokens to winner
winner.transfer(address(this).balance) sends the contract ETH balance to the winner address
exact_tokens (maths.myTokens()) is the amount passed to maths.transfer
maths is instantiated from POWM_address
donateToLottery calls maths.buy.value(msg.value)
buyTickets calls maths.buy.value(msg.value)
closeLotteryAndPickWinner calls maths.transfer on the POWM instance
tokens_bought derives from subtracting tokens_before from tokens_after
tokens_bought derives from tokens_after minus tokens_before divided by 1e18
while (i < tokens_bought) bounds the ticket minting loop
loop index i writes successive ticket slots in gamblers for msg.sender
token_buyins[msg.sender] = tokens_bought stores the computed ticket count
num_tickets_current_round is the modulo divisor of the pseudo-random expression and can be zero
winning_number = hash % num_tickets_current_round, division/modulo by a possibly zero divisor
winner is read out of the gamblers mapping
last_round_bought[msg.sender] = current_round stores the round number
current_round bookkeeping interacts with ticket selection state used by winning_number computation
openLottery increments current_round
constructor sets current_round = 1
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
constructor assigns masternode_referrer = msg.sender
openLottery sets isLotteryOpen = true
closeLotteryAndPickWinner sets isLotteryOpen = false
buyTickets requires isLotteryOpen == true
onlyOwner setMaxTokenBuyin overwrites MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN
the tokens parameter is written into MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN
donateToLottery refreshes numTokensInLottery = maths.myTokens() after the buy
buyTickets refreshes numTokensInLottery = maths.myTokens() after the buy
donateToLottery reads maths.myTokens() into tokens_before
donateToLottery reads maths.myTokens() into tokens_after
buyTickets snapshots maths.myTokens() into tokens_before
buyTickets snapshots maths.myTokens() into tokens_after
buyTickets computes tokens_bought from the token delta
closeLotteryAndPickWinner computes winning_number locally
closeLotteryAndPickWinner resolves the winner locally
closeLotteryAndPickWinner reads maths.myTokens() into exact_tokens before draining
donateToLottery makes an external payable call into the untrusted POWM token contract
buyTickets makes an external payable call into the POWM token contract before updating its own bookkeeping
external call to POWM.transfer lets the token contract execute code before the lottery state is fully settled
raw ETH send to the winner can invoke the winner fallback and reenter closeLotteryAndPickWinner

normalization_plan.reason: the tokens parameter only exists to be validated and assigned to MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN inside setMaxTokenBuyin
tokens_before is a temporary balance snapshot consumed by the donateToLottery token-delta computation
tokens_after is a temporary balance snapshot consumed by the donateToLottery token-delta computation
tokens_bought is the normalized buy-in count driving the ticket loop and MAX_TOKEN_BUYIN check in buyTickets
i is the transient loop counter used only to fill the gamblers mapping in buyTickets
winning_number is the direct result of the block-hash modulo pseudo-random operation
winner is the address dereferenced by the unsafe winner.transfer(address(this).balance) payout
exact_tokens is the amount consumed by the unsafe maths.transfer external call
